pages.title: A obra e a situação

work.title: Walden
work.note: Walden é um livro do escritor americano Henry David Thoreau, publicado em 1854. A cena cultural serve de ponte para o foco “falar de uma subida: reach the top (chegar ao topo) e enjoy the view (curtir a vista)”. A referência mostra uma caminhada no bosque: reach the top, enjoy the view.

pages.title: Tall white columns · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning in Washington, D.C. Pablo and his family stand in front of a big museum. Tall white columns shine in the sun. A long line of tourists moves slowly to the door. At the desk, a woman named Kay waits for them. She smiles and picks up a stack of tickets.
“Welcome to the museum! How many tickets?” says Kay. “Two adults and one child, please.” says Pablo. “Children under twelve are free.” says Kay.
